code-scanning.yml.purpose: Semgrep scan, results uploaded as code-scanning alerts; fails when the scan does not complete

zizmor.yml.purpose: Audit of the caller's workflow YAML (injection, permissions, pins)

dependency-review.yml.purpose: Blocks vulnerable dependencies in a pull request

label-sync.yml.purpose: Applies the canonical label set from `labels.yml`

yamllint.yml.purpose: Lints YAML against the house style (4-space indent)

i18n.yml.purpose: Enforces the catalogue layout; optional `make lang` freshness gate

bundle-freshness.yml.purpose: Verifies committed build artefacts match a clean rebuild

auto-merge-deps.yml.purpose: Auto-merges passing dependency bumps (patch and minor only; `pip` is excluded — see below)

ai-issue-labeler.yml.purpose: Classifies a newly opened issue against the caller's own live label set via the Anthropic API and applies the labels it is confident about — see below

php-quality.yml.purpose: Runs the granular `composer ci:test:php:*` PHP quality gate across a version matrix
